integrity: All-parameter inequalities are established symbolically. Finite exact-rational checks independently reproduce selected cases but are not the proof. Closely related general methods and graph classes were compared; equivalent unindexed work may exist.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers simple, unweighted K_{1,m,m+1}, two distinct equal-gain leaders, finite positive gain, and stationary trace-inverse objective only. No universality for other graph families or heterogeneous gains is asserted.
title: A gain-independent three-phase two-leader law on \(K_{1,m,m+1}\)
